hints.title: Track Sub-Segment Sums
hints.text: Traverse the linked list starting from the node immediately following the initial zero, accumulating node values.

hints.title: Zero Delimiter Encounter
hints.text: When a node with value 0 is reached, create a merged node with the accumulated sum.

hints.title: Reset and Link
hints.text: Reset the running sum to zero and continue until the end of the list.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def mergeNodes(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0)
        tail = dummy
        curr = head.next
        cur_sum = 0
        while curr:
            if curr.val == 0:
                tail.next = ListNode(cur_sum)
                tail = tail.next
                cur_sum = 0
            else:
                cur_sum += curr.val
            curr = curr.next
        return dummy.next
```

complexity.time: O(N) single pass linked list traversal
variables: N: number of nodes in list
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Array conversions add redundant memory allocation and multi-pass overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Streaming node sums directly creates the condensed list in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle dummy pointer and sum reset cleanly.

solutions.approach: Python single pass linked list aggregation.
